# Linux Distribution Picker

> A modern tool to help you find the perfect Linux distribution based on your needs. Answer questions about gaming, development, user-friendliness, and more to get personalized recommendations.

Linux Distribution Picker is a free, open-source web app built with SvelteKit. It features a quick quiz to match users with distros, a searchable grid of Linux distributions with detailed info (desktop environments, beginner-friendliness scores, userbase size, upstream base), and a like/favorites system powered by Supabase.

## Features

- Interactive quiz to find your ideal Linux distribution
- Browse and filter distros by tags (gaming, development, minimal, traditional, etc.)
- Detailed distribution info including desktops, beginner-friendliness, and popularity
- Like and favorite distributions
- Dark and light theme support
- Multilingual support (English, Belarusian)
